# Risk-tier rules for bin/risk-tier. One rule per line:  <glob>   # <reason>
#
# A pull request that touches ANY path matching a rule is "laptop-only": it needs a laptop
# review, not a phone merge. Everything else is "phone-safe". Matching is case-insensitive
# and `*` crosses `/`, so `*consent*` matches any path with "consent" in it. Over-matching
# is deliberate: a wrong laptop-only costs a few minutes, a wrong phone-safe costs a defect.
#
# A rule marked [forward] matches nothing in the tree today and exists for the day a file
# of that kind appears. Every other rule must match at least one tracked file; the test
# suite enforces it. This file itself is a rule target, so editing the rules is laptop-only.

# --- the machinery that decides what merges ---
.github/*                   # CI, CODEOWNERS, dependabot and these rules themselves
bin/*                       # executables, including the scripts that gate merges
*gemfile*                   # dependency set and versions (supply chain)
*.gemspec                   # dependencies and what the gem ships
Rakefile                    # task entry points that CI and releases run
.ruby-version               # runtime version the whole suite is judged on
SECURITY.md                 # security policy and disclosure contact
MIT-LICENSE                 # license text

# --- data shape and boot ---
db/*                        # migrations: irreversible once run against real data
test/dummy/db/*             # the schema the test database is loaded from
config/routes.rb            # adds or removes endpoints
test/dummy/config/initializers/*   # authentication and logging filters are configured here
config/initializers/*       # [forward] engine-level boot configuration

# --- authentication and authorization ---
*authentication*            # who is calling
*smart_*                    # SMART on FHIR launch, configuration and token handling
*backend_*                  # SMART Backend Services: system-to-system client auth
*assertion*                 # signed client assertions and their replay guard
*login*                     # sign-in and its throttling
*launch_context*            # what a launched session is scoped to
*kernel_user*               # the RPMS user a session acts as
*current_user*              # the user a request acts as
*site_gateway*              # site selection at sign-on
*e_signature*               # legal signature on clinical documents
*doorkeeper*                # OAuth server configuration
*oauth*                     # OAuth clients and access tokens
*token*                     # bearer tokens and token bridges
*jwks*                      # client key sets
*jwt*                       # [forward] signed assertions
*session*                   # sign-in sessions and session scope
*policy*                    # authorization policies, redaction and CSP
*compartment*               # patient compartment: what a caller may read

# --- consent, Part 2 and egress ---
*consent*                   # consent decides disclosure
*part2*                     # 42 CFR Part 2 substance-use-disorder segmentation
*part_2*                    # [forward] alternate spelling of the Part 2 surface
*segmentation*              # [forward] data segmentation
*redact*                    # redaction of what leaves the system
*egress*                    # everything that leaves the system
*bulk_export*               # bulk data leaves in volume
*break_glass*               # [forward] emergency override of access controls
*emergency_access*          # emergency access to records

# --- audit and PHI handling ---
*audit*                     # the PHI access trail
*phi_*                      # PHI sanitising and handling
*encrypt*                   # encryption and its verification

# --- tenant boundary ---
*organization*              # the organization/tenant boundary (ADR 0007)
*tenant*                    # [forward] tenant stamping and isolation

# --- money ---
*billing*                   # [forward] money
*claim*                     # [forward] claims
*payment*                   # [forward] payments
*invoice*                   # [forward] invoices

# --- decisions and compliance record ---
docs/adr/*                  # architecture decisions that bind later work
docs/compliance/*           # compliance posture and disclosure audits
docs/certification/*        # certification evidence
SOFTWARE-FACTORY*           # [forward] the review method itself
